questions.stem: 以前一到大熱天，我們就會開冷氣，從不在意電費有多高。
questions.answer: We used to turn on the air conditioning on hot days and never cared how high the electricity bill was.
accepted_answers: On hot days, we used to turn on the air conditioning and never cared how much the electricity bill was.
Whenever it got hot, we used to switch on the air conditioning without caring how high the electric bill was.

questions.stem: 現在我們學會了如何省電，還把家裡的燈泡全都換成省電的。
questions.answer: Now we have learned how to save electricity and have replaced all the light bulbs at home with energy-saving ones.
accepted_answers: Now we know how to save electricity, and we have changed all the light bulbs at home to power-saving ones.
We have now learned how to save power, and all the bulbs in our home have been replaced with energy-saving ones.

1.explanation_zh: 「以前…就會…」說的是過去的習慣，用 used to + 原形動詞（We used to turn on …）。「一到大熱天」中文沒有主詞，英文用 on hot days 或 whenever it got hot。「從不在意電費有多高」：care 後面接間接問句，要用直述句語序 how high the electricity bill was，不能寫成 how high was the bill。開電器用 turn on／switch on，不用 open。
1.strategy_zh: 「以前常常…」用 used to VR；疑問詞帶出的部分放進句子當受詞時，後面一律改回「主詞＋動詞」的語序。
hints: 切成四段：一到大熱天／（以前）我們就會開冷氣／從不在意／電費有多高
標的詞彙：hot（熱的，L1）、turn on（開，L1）、air conditioning（冷氣，L2）、care（在意，L1）、electricity（電，L3）、bill（帳單，L2）
句型框架：S + used to + VR …, and never cared + how + adj. + S + V（直述句語序）

2.explanation_zh: 「學會了如何省電」用 have learned how to save electricity，「如何＋動詞」寫成 how to VR。「把燈泡全都換成省電的」是把字句，英文用 replace A with B（或 change A to B）；「省電的」是複合形容詞 energy-saving，後面用 ones 代替前面提過的 bulbs。
2.strategy_zh: 「如何／怎麼＋動詞」當受詞時用 how to VR；「省…的、節…的」常寫成「名詞－V-ing」的複合形容詞。
hints: 切成四段：現在我們學會了／如何省電／還把家裡的燈泡全都換成／省電的
標的詞彙：learn（學會，L1）、save（節省，L1）、electricity（電，L3）、replace（替換，L3）、bulb（燈泡，L3）、energy-saving（省電的，L2）
句型框架：S + have learned + how to VR …, and have replaced A with energy-saving ones

references: We used to turn on the air conditioning on hot days and never cared how high the electricity bill was.
On hot days, we used to turn on the air conditioning and never cared how much the electricity bill was.
Whenever it got hot, we used to switch on the air conditioning without caring how high the electric bill was.

patterns.label_zh: used to + 原形動詞（過去的習慣）
間接問句（how + adj. + S + V）
patterns.frame: … care + how high/how much + S + V（直述句語序）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「一到大熱天」中文沒有主詞，英文寫成 on hot days，或補主詞 whenever it got hot；when 後面不能只接名詞。
特定的日子用介系詞 on。

accepted: we used to turn on the air conditioning
we used to switch on the air conditioning
we used to turn on the air conditioner
we used to use the air conditioning
we would turn on the air conditioning

common_errors.wrong: we are used to turning on the air conditioning
common_errors.right: we used to turn on the air conditioning
common_errors.explanation_zh: be used to + V-ing 是「習慣於」；「以前都會」是過去的習慣，用 used to + 原形動詞。

common_errors.wrong: we use to turn on the air conditioning
common_errors.right: we used to turn on the air conditioning
common_errors.explanation_zh: 肯定句的「過去常常」要寫 used to，不是 use to。

common_errors.wrong: we used to open the air conditioning
common_errors.right: we used to turn on the air conditioning
common_errors.explanation_zh: 開電器用 turn on／switch on；open 是打開門窗、蓋子。
說的是以前的事，cared 要用過去式，和 used to 的時間一致。
介系詞 without 後面接動名詞 caring。

accepted: how high the electricity bill was
how much the electricity bill was
how high the electric bill was
how high the power bill was
how expensive the electricity bill was
how much we paid for electricity

common_errors.wrong: how high was the electricity bill
common_errors.right: how high the electricity bill was
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句要用直述句語序（主詞＋動詞），不能像問句一樣把 was 移到主詞前面。

common_errors.wrong: how high the electricity fee is
common_errors.right: how high the electricity bill was
common_errors.explanation_zh: 電費帳單是 electricity bill；而且說的是以前，要用過去式 was。

traps.literal_error: We were used to turning on the air conditioning on hot days.
traps.explanation_zh: be used to + V-ing 是「習慣於」，和表示過去習慣的 used to + VR 字形相近、意思不同。

traps.literal_error: When hot days, we used to turn on the air conditioning.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「一到大熱天」沒有主詞，英文要補 it（whenever it got hot），或改成介系詞片語 on hot days。

1.restructuring_zh: 「一到大熱天」中文沒有主詞，英文要補主詞寫成 whenever it got hot，或改成介系詞片語 on hot days；「電費有多高」的問句形式要改成間接問句的直述句語序 how high the electricity bill was。

references: Now we have learned how to save electricity and have replaced all the light bulbs at home with energy-saving ones.
Now we know how to save electricity, and we have changed all the light bulbs at home to power-saving ones.
We have now learned how to save power, and all the bulbs in our home have been replaced with energy-saving ones.

patterns.label_zh: 疑問詞＋不定詞（how to VR）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「現在…學會了」強調到現在已經學會，用現在完成式；也可以直接說 Now we know。
how to 後面接原形動詞。
放在句中當受詞時用 how to VR，或 how we can save …（直述句語序），不用問句語序。

parts.zh: 還把家裡的燈泡全都換成
accepted: have replaced all the light bulbs at home with
have changed all the light bulbs at home to
all the bulbs in our home have been replaced with
have replaced all the bulbs at home with
have replaced all the light bulbs in our home with
have switched all the light bulbs at home to

common_errors.wrong: have replaced all the light bulbs at home to
common_errors.right: have replaced all the light bulbs at home with
common_errors.explanation_zh: replace A with B（用 B 取代 A）；change A to／into B 才用 to。

common_errors.wrong: have changed all the light bulb at home
common_errors.right: have changed all the light bulbs at home
common_errors.explanation_zh: all the 後面的可數名詞用複數。
燈泡會「節省」能源，是主動，複合形容詞用「名詞－V-ing」：energy-saving。
複合形容詞的語序是「受詞名詞－V-ing」，不能把動詞放前面。

traps.literal_error: Now we have replaced all the light bulbs at home to energy-saving ones.
traps.explanation_zh: replace 搭配 with；用 to 是把 change A to B 的用法混進來。

traps.literal_error: We have changed all the light bulbs at home to energy-saved ones.
traps.explanation_zh: 複合形容詞要看主被動：燈泡節省電力是主動，用 energy-saving。

bonus.text: Having learned how to save electricity, we have replaced all the light bulbs at home with energy-saving ones.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用完成式分詞構句 Having learned … 交代先後順序，句子更精簡。

1.translation: We used to turn on the air conditioner whenever it was very hot, never caring how high the electricity bill was.
1.explanation_zh: 「以前……就會」是過去的習慣，用 used to；「一到大熱天」用 whenever 子句；「從不在意」用分詞構句 never caring，後接間接問句 how high the electricity bill was。

2.translation: Now we have learned how to save electricity, and we have even replaced all the light bulbs in our house with energy-saving ones.
2.explanation_zh: 「學會了」用現在完成式 have learned how to V；「把……換成……」用 replace A with B；「省電的」用 energy-saving ones 避免重複 light bulbs；「還」譯 even。

issues_zh: （不影響判定）第 2 部分 accepted 收了 we would turn on the air conditioning，這個寫法沒有用到本句標的句型 BASIC（used to）；若要求學生練 used to，建議在評分說明註明 would 可給分但不算用到標的句型，或移除。
（不影響判定）我的寫法 whenever it was very hot 比 accepted 的 whenever it was hot 多了 very（對應「大」熱天），屬同義小差異。
（不影響判定）我的寫法 have even replaced all the light bulbs in our house with 與 accepted 的 have replaced all the light bulbs in our home with 只差 even（對應「還」）與 house／home，屬同義小差異。

1.translation: We used to turn on the air conditioner whenever it got hot, never caring how high the electricity bill was.
1.explanation_zh: 「以前」對照「現在」，用 used to 表過去習慣；「一到……就」用 whenever；「從不在意」用分詞構句 never caring，後接間接問句。

2.translation: Now we have learned how to save electricity, and we have even replaced all the light bulbs at home with energy-saving ones.
2.explanation_zh: 「現在……學會了」用現在完成式；「還」用 even 加強語氣；「把……換成……」用 replace A with B；「省電的」用 energy-saving ones 避免重複 light bulbs。

issues_zh: 「以前」不在任何一個部分的 zh 裡，但 BASIC 句型（used to，zh_trigger 就是「以前」）卻掛在第二部分「我們就會開冷氣」。
用 In the past 加過去簡單式（In the past, whenever it was hot, we turned on the air conditioning …）也是自然的譯法，但第二部分的 accepted 只有 used to／would，這種寫法會被判錯；建議把「以前」併入第二部分，並補上過去簡單式的可接受寫法。
